eligibility_evidence: Job Description Summary The Commissioning / Roll-out Manager is responsible for the on-site coordination, supervision, and management of installation, integration, testing, and commissioning activities for technology systems within a digital infrastructure project.
The Commissioning Site Manager acts as the primary on-site point of accountability for translating engineering and commissioning plans into safe, coordinated, and timely execution.

Job Description What will you do : Lead and coordinate daily on-site installation activities across multiple technology disciplines, ensuring alignment with project schedules and commissioning milestones.
Additional Information Relocation Assistance Provided: No
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The role ensures that installation activities are properly sequenced and coordinated across multiple contractors and technical disciplines, that systems are installed in accordance with design and manufacturer requirements, and that the site is progressively made ready for testing, commissioning, and customer handover. Ensure equipment and systems are installed in accordance with approved designs, specifications, manufacturer requirements, and project standards. Ensure compliance with site health, safety, security, access control, permit, and energisation requirements while promoting a strong safety culture. Minimum 3 years of site-based experience in technology infrastructure installation, systems integration, or commissioning, ideally within data centers, telecommunications, or digital infrastructure projects. Proficient in the use of Microsoft Office tools.
